scope: Twelve focused real-Git/Windows checks cover preserved runner deployment, package-cache deletion during validation followed by a guarded large-file repair, native helper survival, restart, same-PID service startup, stop/resume, adoption/lease ownership, publication/pull recovery, original repair deadlines and read-only observation. Model proposals are controlled fixtures; no paid inference was used. Two additional native-diagnostic regressions pass separately, retaining actual Unity failure messages instead of only the subprocess wrapper.

queueAcceptance.scope: Fresh focused deployment/lifecycle and affected queue regressions; no consumer mutation during source tests.

limits: No rendered/physical checks, new whole-game certification, paid inference or legacy migration. Development tests do not install or start a consumer publisher.

evidenceReuse.reason: C# implementation, assembly definitions, dependencies and supported example are unchanged except the brick version string; reuse 0.5.3 native presentation/example, full rebuild and 31-assembly default-diagnostic results.

additionalAcceptance.scope: Complete native exception/assertion/compiler context from large Unity logs; unsupported and oversized native evidence stops before paid inference.
